contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose an Alpine login prompt reachable via telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is demonstrated.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process launched from the Alpine ISO
Launch/probe receipts showing the VM stayed up and the login prompt was observed
required_behaviors: QEMU must run detached/backgrounded and remain running
Port 6665 must connect to the guest login service
A telnet probe to 127.0.0.1:6665 must show the login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving QEMU starts without verifying the prompt
Only checking that port 6665 is open without prompt text
Launching QEMU in the foreground so the task is not left running
verification_plan: Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts
Launch QEMU with user networking and hostfwd tcp::6665-:23, capturing logs
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the Alpine login prompt appears
Keep the VM running after verification
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt for the QEMU launch command
Receipt for a successful telnet/netcat probe showing the login prompt
notes: If the ISO does not boot directly to a login prompt, adjust console/boot parameters while preserving the original objective.
